pending_review_tasks.description: countTaskCompletions() in src/sessions/store.ts:1654 and extractTaskTransitions() rely on rawInput.command being a plain string containing 'task complete'. Two ACP adapters break this: (1) claude-agent-acp sets rawInput to {} (empty) — command never recorded in rawInput.command, (2) codex-acp sets rawInput.command to an array like ['/usr/bin/bash', '-lc', 'kspec task complete @ref'] instead of a string. Result: kspec session log list shows Tasks=0 for all sessions since ~Feb 24. Fix: normalize command extraction to handle string, array, and _meta.claudeCode fallback formats. Affects both countTaskCompletions and extractTaskTransitions in store.ts.

recent_notes.task_title: Fix session task counting for claude-agent-acp and codex-acp adapters
recent_notes.author: @claude
recent_notes.content:
Root cause analysis complete:

countTaskCompletions (store.ts:1682) has two bugs:
1. Line 1696: quick-filter checks !line.includes('"tool_call"') which excludes 'tool_call_update' events — but for claude-agent-acp, the command data arrives in tool_call_update events (rawInput is empty {} in the initial tool_call event)
2. Line 1700: only handles typeof command === 'string' — codex-acp sets command as an array like ['/usr/bin/bash', '-lc', 'kspec task complete @ref'], actual command is at index 2

extractTaskTransitions (store.ts:2001) has similar bug: only handles string command, not array format.

Fix:
- countTaskCompletions: remove the '"tool_call"' filter restriction (allow tool_call_update too), and normalize array commands to extract command[2]
- extractTaskTransitions: same array normalization

Evidence: working session 01KJ6NFBH (feb 24, claude-code-acp) stores commands as strings in tool_call_update events. Session 01KJMTEA (codex-acp) stores commands as arrays in tool_call events.

recent_notes.task_title: Fix batch exec copying sessions/blobs to temp dir
recent_notes.author: @claude
recent_notes.content:
WIP checkpoint: WriteBuffer class and tests complete, batch-exec.ts wiring not yet done.

Done:
- src/cli/batch-write-buffer.ts: WriteBuffer class with write/read/delete/has/flush/discard, staging-file atomicity for ac-7, module singleton (activate/deactivate/get)
- tests/batch-write-buffer.test.ts: unit tests for all ACs including integration tests verifying no sessions/ copy and atomic rollback

Remaining (next session):
- Wire WriteBuffer into src/cli/batch-exec.ts executeAtomic():
  1. Remove fs.cp(realSpecDir, tempDir) at ~line 643
  2. Call activateBatchBuffer(realSpecDir) instead
  3. Replace the fs.writeFile path inside the command runner to call buffer.write() (or intercept via an env var / patched writeFile in the subprocess)
  4. Replace clear+copy-back block (~lines 690-703) with buffer.flush() on success, buffer.discard() on failure
  5. Call deactivateBatchBuffer() in finally

Note: The subprocess model means each command runs in a separate spawnSync call. The buffer singleton won't span across spawned processes. Need to re-evaluate approach — either (a) make batch commands run in-process instead of spawned subprocesses, or (b) use a temp file protocol for buffered writes between parent and child. See batch-exec.ts for the exact spawn model before deciding.

inbox_items.text: Cross-feature requirement pattern: How to express that core features (search, validate, export) must support all entity types. When new entity type added, should automatically imply tasks for core features. Options: (1) applies_to field on feature specs, (2) trait on entity types like @trait-searchable, (3) validation warning for missing coverage, (4) parent spec that entity types must satisfy. Surfaced when realizing search doesn't cover inbox.

Reverse spec lookup - kspec which <file> or kspec which <file:line> to find specs/ACs that reference or are implemented by a given code path. Useful for bug fixes to quickly discover what specs need updating. Could scan for // AC: annotations and spec_ref links. Instructive, helps find already-instrumented code.

Add cross-platform CI matrix testing - run core functionality tests on Windows, macOS, and Linux. Would catch issues like Unix-specific commands (which, cp -r) before they reach PR review. Consider: matrix strategy in GitHub Actions, platform-specific test skips where needed, focus on CLI commands and daemon lifecycle.
E2E tests: Use isolated port range (not 3456) + cross-platform cleanup. Current approach conflicts with existing daemons. Should use high ephemeral port range and improve cleanup mechanism.
E2E test dev mode - configure Playwright to work with vite dev server instead of requiring full build for faster test iteration (12+ seconds to 1-2 seconds)

Improve derive granularity: Research suggests specs with 4+ ACs are candidates for splitting. Potential enhancements: (1) --by-ac flag to create tasks per AC group, (2) --max-acs N to auto-group, (3) implementation_phases field in specs, (4) derive templates for common patterns (cli-command, api-endpoint), (5) complexity warnings when specs are too large. See session research on task decomposition patterns from Linear, Atlassian, BDD/Example Mapping, and AI coding assistants.

Daemon debugging improvements: (1) Add --log-file or --verbose to 'kspec serve start', (2) Log resolved web UI path on startup, (3) Capture and show stderr when daemon fails to start within timeout. Consolidated from @01KFQ586, @01KFQ595, @01KFPH3D.

Project config file (kspec.config.yaml or .kspecrc): Configure shadow remote URL (enable separate repo for specs), feature toggles, default values (author, priority), validation strictness. Enables multi-repo projects sharing specs and tailoring kspec to project needs. Consolidated from @01KFGVVJ, @01KFGVVN.

AC test coverage analysis: 'kspec coverage @spec-ref' command to scan codebase for '// AC: @spec ac-N' annotations and report which ACs have test coverage vs gaps. Soft check for review, not blocking. Consolidated from @01KFHJNR, @01KFP9A6.

Shadow sync improvements: (1) Auto-resolve using rebase/merge-driver for cleaner sync, (2) Make sync warnings visible in CLI output (currently silent unless KSPEC_DEBUG=1), (3) Auto-detect common issues with suggested fixes. Consolidated from @01KFTDA7, @01KFHZR4.

CLI array field flag patterns: (1) Generic --clear <field> or --<field> [] for clearing arrays, (2) --add-<field> vs multiple flags for append semantics. Design unified approach for depends-on, tags, blocked-by, etc. Consolidated from @01KFGRV6, @01KFR0KN.

Inbox CLI improvements: (1) Add filtering to list: --before/--after <date>, --author <name> (--tag exists), (2) Add merge command: 'kspec inbox merge @source @target' for consolidating duplicates, (3) Add --priority and --automation flags to promote command. Consolidated from @01KG95JP, @01KG95JQ, @01KG95JS.

Workflow CLI improvements: (1) 'workflow show' should infer active run like 'workflow next', (2) Warn when --input flags passed but step has no inputs defined, (3) Improve 'workflow show' output format with vertical display, status indicators, indented notes. Consolidated from @01KFKSF6, @01KFKSGC, @01KFKTNR.

Spec item slug/addressing improvements: (1) Warn/error on slug collision when creating items, (2) Make nested requirements addressable by slug (currently kspec item ac add @slug fails for items under requirements:). Consolidated from @01KGDCRG, @01KGDCRJ.

Expand @trait-multi-ref-batch to remaining commands: trait add/remove, task set --automation, inbox delete, task note. Enables batch operations like 'kspec task note @ref1 @ref2 @ref3 "shared content"'. Consolidated from @01KG71J2, @01KG95JM, @01KFVXBM.
Add --spec-ref filter to kspec task list command to filter tasks by linked spec item

Workflow lifecycle CLI design (from mining run 01KFS6MJ): kspec workflow complete @run-ref (mark run completed, archive), kspec workflow cancel @run-ref (cancel abandoned run), kspec workflow cleanup --older-than Nd (auto-cancel stale runs). Extends existing @01KFPH39 auto-cleanup with concrete subcommand design.

Item list --module flag and tree view: kspec item list --module cli to scope output to a specific module. kspec item tree @module for hierarchical view (features -> requirements). Currently 50+ items display flat, making it hard to find the right parent for new specs. Friction: during automation triage had to grep YAML files to find parent specs.

Define typed event data schemas per EventType — session.start, session.update (with tool_call/sessionUpdate variants), session.end, prompt.sent, tool.call, tool.result, note. Current z.unknown() data field makes it impossible to reliably query events without reverse-engineering from real JSONL files.

Session log compaction: at end of each ralph loop, replace raw events.jsonl with a compiled stats file (event counts by type, tool usage frequency, duration, task transitions, error summary). Keep session folders and context snapshots intact but prune the raw log. This gives trend analysis capability without unbounded log growth. Could be a kspec session compact command or automatic post-loop step.

Active context from meta: use the meta database (observations, conventions, patterns) as a dynamic context source that automatically surfaces relevant entries based on current activity. E.g. when reviewing plan-import code, auto-surface friction observations tagged with plan-import. When doing code review, pull in resolved friction patterns as review priors. Replaces manual markdown maintenance (AGENTS.md, skill docs) with structured data that stays current as observations accumulate. Could use conventions or a new meta item type for durable patterns distinct from one-off observations.

Centralize daemon port default (3456) — currently hardcoded in 6 places: src/schema/spec.ts, src/cli/index.ts, src/cli/commands/serve.ts, packages/daemon/src/index.ts, packages/web-ui/src/lib/constants.ts, packages/web-ui/tests/fixtures/test-base.ts. Extract to a shared constant to prevent drift.

Formalize CLI usage analysis as a repeatable workflow. Tools exist in .claude-research/tools/ (parse-ralph-logs.mjs, parse-claude-logs.mjs, compile-data.mjs) plus interactive HTML report. Consider: kspec skill, CLI command, or standalone workflow. Re-run after implementing the 6 CLI agent-UX improvements to measure impact.

Add repeated-flag support to --status filter (ac-repeated-flag gap from PR #354). Commander.js .option() needs a collect function to accumulate repeated --status flags into an array. Currently only comma-separated works. Small fix: change .option('-s, --status <status>') to use Commander's variadic/collect pattern, then feed array into parseMultiStatus().

Shadow branch diff/changelog — since .kspec/ is git-tracked, we could show changes to stored artifacts (workflows, tasks, specs, inbox) over time. Something like kspec history @ref or kspec diff --since '1 week ago' that leverages the git history on kspec-meta branch. Could show task state transitions, spec evolution, workflow modifications, etc.
Version pinning: all projects use whatever global kspec version is installed. No lock file or constraint resolution. Consider adding version constraints to kynetic.yaml manifest.
Memory seeding: seed MEMORY.md with project-relevant starting notes during kspec setup. Could bootstrap agent effectiveness in new projects.

Tech debt: Pre-existing test anti-patterns - daemon-api-projects.test.ts has 10 no-op tests behind existsSync guards. ralph.test.ts and ralph-context-refresh.test.ts have conditional assertions without preceding guard assertions. Not from ralph loop but should fix.

Fix daemon-executable.test.ts - bun build --compile fails when routes import from parent packages. Pre-existing failure, root cause: ESM imports from parent packages can't be bundled. AC-16 on @daemon-server claimed complete but test doesn't pass.

kspec tasks assess automation --all should display stored automation status (eligible/needs_review/manual_only) alongside criteria recommendation. Currently only shows criteria-based recommendation even for already-assessed tasks, making it impossible to verify batch operations.
Silent error swallowing in setup pipeline: multiple bare catch {} blocks in setup.ts lose diagnostic info. At minimum should log at debug/verbose level for troubleshooting.

Legacy renderClaudeCodeSkill diverges from claudeCodeRenderer: uses old writeRenderHash (not platform-specific), lacks outputDir support, returns old type. setup.ts still uses it. Should route through registry and deprecate standalone function.

Codex and Claude Code renderers share ~70% duplicated render logic (content loading, frontmatter stripping, idempotency check, file writing, hash storage, dir copying). Extract shared base render function with hooks for platform-specific steps.

---

Triage 2026-02-22: 8/13 sub-items RESOLVED by PRs #408 #412 #403. Remaining: getSetupStatus staleness, skill update mutation, naming inconsistency, redundant defaults, deprecated_target reuse.
getSetupStatus always reports "current" if hash file exists, cannot detect staleness. Should load meta context and compare hash to detect when agents.md needs regeneration.
skill update mutates loaded skill objects in-place before saveMetaItem. If save fails partway, in-memory state diverges from disk. Should copy before mutation.
Naming inconsistency: isKspecManagedSkill (skill-render.ts) vs isKspecManaged (skill.ts) for same logic. Standardize to one name.
Redundant platform/tags/depends_on defaults in skill CLI — manually set before SkillSchema.safeParse which already applies them. Remove manual defaults.
deprecated_target warning type reused for skill-specific warnings (depends_on validation, orphaned dirs). Add proper skill warning types for better filtering.

Ralph loop consolidation pass: add a cleanup/consolidation iteration every N PRs or at loop end. The PR-by-PR review process misses cross-PR duplication accumulation — 32 PRs in last loop produced 24 inbox items of tech debt. A periodic consolidation step would catch dead code, duplicated utilities, and superseded implementations before they compound.

Codex skill: handle own-PR reviews — GitHub rejects REQUEST_CHANGES on your own PRs, Codex should use COMMENT event instead. Bundle this fix with skill importing refinement so it propagates to all projects.

Task-specific ephemeral AC: Support acceptance criteria directly on tasks (not just via spec_ref). Useful for implementation requirements, refactoring criteria, and one-off work that doesn't warrant a spec item. Task ACs would be checked during review but wouldn't live in the spec hierarchy. Addresses the gap where plan-imported ACs are behavioral specs vs task-level implementation requirements.

skill-render.ts lines 492, 730, 924 have LF-only frontmatter regexes. Low risk in render path (kspec generates these files with LF) but should be hardened for consistency with the CRLF fixes in skill.ts/validate-skills.ts.

Feature request: ralph loop boundary tracking in session logs. Currently no easy way to see what happened in a ralph loop iteration without cross-referencing PR timestamps, git log, and task states. A session log showing PR-to-task mapping per loop iteration would help audit and review. Originated from imgen project observation.

Design section configuration for agents generate — allow projects to control which sections appear (skills table, conventions, workflows, static templates). Key questions: where does config live, include vs exclude list, defaults, custom sections, ordering, data vs template distinction, migration path. See plan doc for full requirements.
Inbox tag management: no way to add/remove tags on existing inbox items. Only settable at creation via inbox add --tag. Need: kspec inbox tag add @ref <tag> and kspec inbox tag remove @ref <tag>.

Batch command arg naming inconsistency: inbox add accepts tag (singular) not tags. No documentation of which args each batch command accepts. Consider: consistent plural naming or better error messages with valid arg list.

Stale workflow runs accumulate: no way to prune or auto-expire old runs. After many sessions, every workflow next command requires specifying a run ID because 7+ active runs exist. Need: kspec workflow prune (expire runs older than N days) or kspec workflow cancel @run-id.

When spawning parallel review agents (e.g. Codex + /pr-review), instruct the /pr-review agent not to merge — only review. The parent agent should control the merge decision after all reviews complete. Update /pr-review skill or add a --no-merge flag.

Template/example repo for new kspec consumers: either a GitHub template repo or 'kspec create-project' command showing a fully configured consumer project (manifest, CLAUDE.md with @kspec-agents.md, skills, hooks). Real consumer projects (kynetic-bot, imgen, comfy-ecaj-nodes) serve as informal examples but a clean minimal template would lower onboarding friction.

Per-module task files and task archiving: Original design intent was project.tasks.yaml for non-spec tasks, <module>.tasks.yaml for module-scoped tasks. Never fully implemented — everything goes to project.tasks.yaml. Tradeoffs: splitting reduces file size (comfy-ecaj-nodes has 97 tasks in one file) but requires reading more files. Related: need task archiving to move completed tasks out of the active file. Both address the same scaling problem (task files growing unbounded) from different angles.

kspec validate @spec or @task — targeted validation that checks a single spec/task's AC coverage against codebase. Not full approval, just verifies each AC has at least one // AC: annotation in test files. Would make trait AC gaps immediately visible during task-work. Could be used by local-review skill as a concrete check instead of relying on agent diligence.
CLI DX: accept tags as alias for tag in batch commands
CLI DX: accept spec_ref as alias for spec-ref in batch commands
CLI DX: accept P1/P2/P3 format as alias for numeric priority in batch commands
CLI DX: add --description flag to task set command (currently requires task patch --data)

Terminal exit code display in ralph CLI renderer — claude-agent-acp PR #316 adds _meta.terminal_exit.exit_code on Bash tool completions (opt-in via clientCapabilities._meta.terminal_output). Low priority, ~40 lines across events.ts + cli-renderer.ts. Only concrete gain from the terminal streaming protocol — the output data itself is identical to existing _meta.claudeCode.toolResponse path. Worth adopting if Bash failure debugging becomes a pain point.

Bash code fence language change in claude-agent-acp v0.18.0 — formatted Bash output changed from ```sh to ```console. Check if ralph's noise suppression patterns, session log rendering, or any regex patterns in cli-renderer.ts or events.ts match on the code fence language. Low risk since ralph primarily reads from _meta.claudeCode.toolResponse not content blocks, but worth a grep.

Surface ACP usage/cost data in ralph session stats — after SDK bump to 0.14.x, new Usage/UsageUpdate/Cost types are available. Could add token usage per iteration and cumulative cost to session log stats and web UI. The usage_update SessionUpdate variant fires during sessions with context window utilization data.

---

IMPORTANT FINDING: Neither claude-agent-acp nor codex-acp actually emit usage_update events or populate PromptResponse.usage. Both have raw token data available but discard it. kynetic-bot works around this by scraping /context stderr (fragile regex). Upstream PR to claude-agent-acp is highest-value path — Anthropic API stream events contain usage data, just needs wiring to ACP protocol.

Explore CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE mode for ralph loops — sets minimal system prompt with only Bash, file read, and file edit tools. Disables MCP tools, attachments, hooks, and CLAUDE.md. Could reduce token overhead and speed up startup, but ralph would need to inject all project context (AGENTS.md rules, spec-first workflow, kspec conventions) into the prompt itself instead of relying on Claude Code's built-in mechanisms. Tradeoff: simpler/faster agent vs ralph becomes responsible for all context bootstrapping. Ref: anthropics/claude-code#27019

Ralph worktree isolation for task work — spawn each agent in a git worktree under a gitignored .worktrees/ dir for branch isolation. Pattern proven in kynetic-internal with jj workspaces. Key insight: kspec resolves .kspec/ via git root, but worktrees return their own root from rev-parse --show-toplevel. Solution: ralph sets KSPEC_SPEC_DIR to point to main tree's .kspec/ when spawning agents (env var already exists for batch mode). Benefits: isolated branches per task, parallel agent work, trivial cleanup of failed work, clean main branch. Unknowns: shadow branch commands from worktree context, git config inheritance, worktree lifecycle management in ralph.

Single-source task state diagram: currently duplicated in AGENTS.md, templates/agents-sections/03-task-lifecycle.md, and src/cli/help/content.ts. Adding needs_work required updating all three independently. Generate from schema or single template to avoid triple-update when adding states.

Distinguish behavioral vs testable ACs in kspec validate: workflow ACs (agent behavioral specs enforced by skills/prompts) get flagged as uncovered in test coverage, creating false MUST-FIX findings in reviews. Allow tagging ACs or specs as agent-enforced to report separately from code-testable ACs.
inbox promote missing --slug option: cannot set task slug during promotion, must use default auto-generated slug. Add --slug <slug> option to inbox promote command.
CLI gap: kspec skill set should support --id to rename a skill without delete+recreate

Spec and test kspec behavior without git: ensure kspec works in projects without git initialized, and handles git being introduced into an existing project where kspec is already in use. Cover shadow branch initialization, worktree setup on first git init, migration of .kspec/ state when git appears, and graceful degradation of git-dependent features (auto-commit, sync, shadow status).

Session checkpoint hook noise: fires repeatedly for intentionally uncommitted files (e.g. generated reports). No way to suppress for specific paths. Could support .kspec/checkpoint-ignore listing paths to exclude from dirty-tree check, or respect gitignore-like patterns. Fired 6+ times in one session for a triage report artifact.

CLI parity: kspec task add requires --title flag but kspec inbox add accepts positional text argument. task add should accept positional title for consistency. Small change in Commander.js argument definition.

Plugin registry tests: validate structurally instead of exact output matching. Current tests assert exact JSON shapes (e.g. source field structure) which breaks when Claude Code schema evolves. Better: (1) Validate marketplace.json against a Zod schema capturing required fields (plugins array, name, source, version) rather than exact values. (2) Test build output structurally — 'has plugins array with our entry' not exact field matching. (3) For known_marketplaces.json registry, test entry exists with valid path, not exact source object shape. Motivation: the source field assertion broke twice already (local → directory object) because tests coupled to implementation details.

Include triage records in static snapshot (kspec-snapshot.json). Currently the snapshot format (KspecSnapshot type) doesn't include triage records, so the triage page in static/GitHub Pages mode shows an empty state with a notice instead of displaying existing triage decisions read-only. AC-8 of @interactive-triage-ui expects read-only display. Needs: add triage records to export snapshot, update KspecSnapshot type, add fetchTriageRecordsStatic to read from snapshot.

Web UI list pages hardcode limit: 1000 with no pagination — triage page confirmed, likely affects inbox/tasks pages too. Silent truncation for large datasets. Need pagination or virtual scrolling pattern across all list views.

Trait AC annotation gaps on @triage-cli-commands: @trait-error-guidance ac-3, @trait-semantic-exit-codes ac-3/4/6/7, @trait-filterable-list ac-2, @trait-shadow-commit ac-2/3/4/6/7/8, @trait-dry-run ac-4/6. Pre-existing, not introduced by PR #458.
Web UI WebSocket connection unreliable - continually disconnects and reconnects. Needs investigation into reconnection logic, heartbeat handling, or fallback to polling.
Web UI triage page: add filter controls for triage action types (promote, delete, defer, spec-gap, duplicate). Currently no way to filter triage records by action.
Web UI: persist all filter state and current view in URL query params so refreshing the page preserves state. Applies to all list/filter pages (triage, inbox, tasks, etc).

Triage promote action should optionally delete the inbox item after creating the task. Currently promoted items stay in inbox requiring manual cleanup. Consider --consume flag or making deletion the default for promote (with snapshot preserved in triage record).

ULID short ref ambiguity in batch operations: when two ULIDs share a prefix (e.g. 01KJ4SNE9 and 01KJ4SNEC), short refs like @01KJ4SNE fail. kspec already has a shortest-unique-ID utility — this should be used anywhere refs are displayed (triage list, task list, inbox list, promote result_ref, etc.) so that presented refs are always unambiguous and copy-pasteable into subsequent commands.

Agents should check plan_ref when starting tasks. If a task has plan_ref, run kspec plan get @plan-ref to read implementation notes, algorithm details, and context. Update task-work skill and task-work-loop workflow to include this step. Plans are the right place for rich implementation context instead of cramming it into task notes.

Plan import --update replaces all ACs instead of merging. When extending an existing spec with a new AC via plan import, --update overwrites acceptance_criteria entirely. Need AC-merge strategy: append new AC IDs, preserve existing ones. Encountered during spec-plan for session-log-show ac-10.

Plan import warnings treated as errors in batch mode. The no YAML code block in specs section warning causes batch atomic rollback even though the task creation succeeded. Warnings should not cause batch failure — only actual errors should.

Ralph event handler iteration attribution should use session-scoped mapping instead of shared mutable currentIteration. Codex review on PR #484 identified that late updates from a previous ACP session can still be tagged with wrong iteration. Use session_id→iteration map or session-scoped listener. See PR #484 review comment.

CLI args should accept both kebab-case and underscore variants (e.g. depends-on and depends_on). Currently batch commands reject underscore variants even though the error message suggests the kebab form. Normalizing both forms would reduce friction, especially for agents generating JSON batch payloads where underscore is the natural convention.

kspec batch --commands '' hangs instead of erroring — empty/missing args should fail fast with a clear error, not block on stdin. Discovered when ralph loop got stuck calling batch with empty string arg.

Session-scoped workflow runs: workflow runs could carry a session_id, filtering workflow show/list to current session by default. Session end could auto-close orphaned runs. Reduces noise when multiple sessions active (ralph + interactive). Natural fit since workflows are already ephemeral.

Ralph loop logs 'Unexpected case' for rate_limit_event messages from Claude API. These are informational SSE events (status: allowed) that the event handler doesn't recognize. Should either handle gracefully (ignore/log at debug level) or add to known event types. Currently noisy in ralph output.

Ralph loop needs iteration-level timeout. When a spawned agent gets stuck (e.g., tool call hanging on stdin), ralph has no mechanism to detect or recover. A configurable per-iteration timeout (e.g., 15-20 min) that kills the stuck agent and logs the failure would prevent indefinite hangs. Separate from Claude Code's per-bash-command timeout which didn't prevent the kspec batch stdin hang.

Shadow branch index inconsistency: observation @01KJ73ME appeared in search results but failed on kspec item get. Possible write conflict or index corruption during ralph loop session. Investigate shadow branch integrity.

Ralph CLI renderer: parallel tool calls produce confusing output. tool_result events render sequentially with no association to their tool_start, so when multiple tools run in parallel, results appear under the wrong header. Fix: include tool summary (e.g. filename) in the completed/failed status line so each result is self-identifying regardless of interleaving.

Tests fail when run inside ralph loop due to environment contamination: (1) ralph.test.ts KSPEC_RALPH_SESSION assertion expects null but env var is inherited from ralph process, (2) session-create.test.ts active session warning in stderr breaks JSON parsing, (3) session-budget-integration.test.ts references nonexistent task set-automation command. Tests should isolate from parent process env vars (KSPEC_RALPH_SESSION, KSPEC_SESSION_ID) to be reliable in all contexts.
Session event log tool-level filtering: kspec session log show <id> --tool Read would avoid grep/python one-liners when debugging ralph event issues

kspec task set --priority accepts numbers (1-5) but all documentation, conventions, and plan documents use P1/P2/P3 notation. Error message says 'Priority must be a number between 1 and 5' which is confusing when you've been writing P1 everywhere. Should either accept both formats or align documentation with the numeric API.

kspec meta set convention: add --update-rule and --remove-rule flags. Currently the only way to fix a rule is to delete the entire convention and recreate it. Surfaced during skill CLI lookups task when codex review caught a wording issue in one rule.

kspec setup should work without CLAUDECODE=1 env var in non-interactive contexts. Either add a --agent flag (e.g. kspec setup --agent claude-code) to explicitly specify the agent type, or detect based on installed tooling (~/.claude exists) rather than requiring runtime env vars. Discovered while building containerized ralph runner — entrypoint bash script can't set CLAUDECODE=1 globally because claude blocks nested sessions.

kspec agents generate should include package version in content hash (or add --force flag) so version bumps during releases automatically trigger regeneration. Currently skips because content is identical, but the version comment in the header is stale. Workaround: manually edit the version line.

Ralph PR merge should auto-delete remote branches after merge. Currently accumulates stale branches (found 13 after one session). The gh pr merge command supports --delete-branch. Add to pr-review-loop workflow merge step.

Session summary/stats command — kspec session stats @id or kspec session show @id --summary. Parse events.jsonl to show: iteration count, tasks started/completed/blocked, PRs created/merged, total duration, exit reason. Currently requires custom python scripts to extract from 14k+ line event logs.

@cmd-validate spec is stale — missing flags: --completeness, --staleness, --drift, --alignment, --skills, --conventions (all already implemented in code). Pre-existing drift, not introduced by trait AC task.
Fix @observations slug ambiguity — kspec validate reports 6 errors for duplicate slug. Pre-existing issue across main.
Triage API spec says ac-4 and ac-5 use PUT method but implementation uses POST /:ref/override and POST /:ref/act. Spec needs updating to match reality.
Triage ac-5 says sets result_ref but delete action may not produce one. Verify behavior and update spec or add test assertion.
kspec task patch appears to hang indefinitely — had to kill and use task set + task note as workaround
Plan import: generate richer task descriptions from Implementation Notes section — include file paths, what to change, verification steps instead of generic 'See plan...' text
Merge driver: auto-resolve .kspec-agents-hash file conflicts (deterministic hash, should always take latest)
Shadow repair: handle missing /bin/sh — use direct git commands instead of spawning shell, fails on fish-only systems

Handle EPIPE in ACP framing layer — src/acp/framing.ts send() throws uncaught EPIPE when child process pipe is dead during shutdown. Should catch EPIPE and treat as connection-closed. Currently requires process-level uncaughtException handlers in tests that spawn/kill agents.

Add second mock adapter registration for ralph tests. Currently --adapter-cmd registers a single 'custom' adapter, making it impossible to test different adapter IDs in real (non-dry-run) runs. Options: (1) --worker-adapter-cmd / --reviewer-adapter-cmd flags, (2) env-based adapter registration (e.g. KSPEC_TEST_ADAPTERS JSON), (3) allow --adapter-cmd to accept an optional name prefix like --adapter-cmd 'worker:node mock.js'. This would enable proper integration tests for ac-2 (reviewer subagent uses reviewer adapter), ac-7 (env injection for both adapters with different harness targets), and ac-12 (different adapter IDs in session metadata). Currently these are covered by code-level AC annotations and dry-run output tests, but lack end-to-end verification with the mock ACP.

kspec validate should warn about items with identical titles in the same module — two items both named 'Generation Progress UX' with different ULIDs caused confusion during a fix session in imgen project

Task budget false-positive outside ralph loop when stale KSPEC_SESSION_ID is present (observed in codex session). Repro: with KSPEC_SESSION_ID set to an old session that has budget.json started_this_cycle=max_per_cycle, 'kspec task start @ref' fails with 'Task budget exhausted ... let iteration end naturally' even when not running ralph and no in-progress tasks. Expected: budget guard should apply only during active ralph loop iteration context, or stale/non-ralph session IDs should be ignored.

Diagnose skill verify drift/no-hash for plugin-provided core skills.

Observed behavior:
- kspec skill verify reports codex statuses as drifted/no-hash for help, observations, triage, reflect, triage-inbox, writing-specs.
- kspec skill diff reports plugin-provided (no local render to diff).
- Rendered skill files exist under .agents/skills.

Investigate:
- render-hash semantics in .kspec/skills for plugin-provided skills
- plugin-provided status handling in skill verify/status/diff paths
- whether this is expected behavior or a bug in drift detection

task set --description: task set has no --description option, making it impossible to update task descriptions after creation. Workaround: add detailed task notes. Came up when plan-derived task had null description and needed standalone context for automation.

derive_from_specs produces sparse tasks: derived tasks get null description, no tags, automation unassessed. Agents picking up these tasks lack context to work independently. Consider: auto-populate description from spec description, copy plan tags, or allow plan document to specify per-task fields.
Reflection follow-up: add explicit parent/ancestor context to kspec item get output (human and --json) so hierarchy is unambiguous without separate tree queries.
Reflection follow-up: add optional ancestor-chain display for kspec item list --tree --search so matched descendants show parent context and avoid false orphan interpretation.
Reflection follow-up: add validation check for trait/command-contract contradictions (e.g., command AC prohibits --refs while applied traits require batch refs semantics).

Unified kspec get @ref dispatch: currently plans require 'kspec plan get' while specs/tasks use 'kspec item get' / 'kspec task get'. A single 'kspec get @ref' that auto-dispatches to the right entity type would reduce friction for agents and humans who don't know the entity type upfront.
Add stale-dist guard for CLI-based tests: detect outdated dist/cli build in tests/helpers/cli.ts and fail fast with actionable guidance (or optional auto-build) to avoid misleading failures.

Meta workflow editing gap: kspec meta set cannot update workflow steps. Agents must delete+recreate workflow to edit a step, which can churn workflow ULIDs and temporarily break references. Add safe step-level update support (e.g., --set-step <index> --content/--on-fail) or preserve ULID on replace to avoid reference drift.

Worktree guard escape hatch: add env var KSPEC_GUARD_OVERRIDE_DONT_USE that bypasses the guard hook for intentional recovery operations (git reset, rebase in .kspec). Name deliberately long to discourage agent use — humans-only for recovery scenarios.

Add commit-scope guard for automated task work: before committing, detect pre-existing staged files unrelated to the current task and prevent accidental inclusion (or require explicit acknowledgment). In this iteration, unrelated staged files were included because they were already in the index before git add on task files.

tests/ralph.test.ts helper runRalph splits args on whitespace, so quoted values (e.g., --focus "keep scope narrow") break and cause misleading unknown-command/option failures. Improve helper to accept argv arrays or robust shell-like parsing for test args.

Reflection: fix-cycle ergonomics mismatch — task-work guidance says 're-submit' needs_work tasks, but CLI rejects kspec task submit when status is needs_work and requires explicit kspec task start first. Consider allowing direct submit from needs_work (auto-transition to in_progress) or improving error/help text to show required two-step command sequence.

Shadow branch auto-push silently swallows failures — fire-and-forget push (shadow.ts:1159-1164) uses spawn with stdio:ignore and detached:true, making divergence errors completely invisible. In a 4-hour ralph container session, 50+ commits accumulated locally with no indication pushes were failing. The push fails because host and container both commit to kspec-meta concurrently, causing divergence on the first push attempt, and every subsequent auto-push also fails silently. Fix should: (1) capture push exit code even in fire-and-forget mode (spawn with stdio:pipe, read stderr, unref after), (2) on push failure, log warning to stderr so it appears in agent output and JSON mode, (3) consider returning a result from autoCommit/shadowPush indicating push status so callers can surface it (e.g. kspec batch could include push_failed:true in response), (4) on repeated failures, escalate visibility — e.g. after 3 consecutive push failures, emit a prominent warning. The local commit always succeeds regardless — this is about VISIBILITY of sync failures, not blocking commits. Related: the merge driver handles YAML conflicts well (56/57 commits rebased cleanly), so the recovery path works — the problem is purely that nobody knows recovery is needed.

tests/cli/session-note-limit.test.ts has reproducible timeout instability in current baseline. During this iteration: full npm test timed out at lines 34/70/104, and isolated run timed out at lines 34/104 despite rebuilding. This appears separate from ralph prompt changes and indicates session-start note-limit path/perf regression or test flake that should be stabilized.

Reflection: add file-based payload input to task notes (e.g., kspec task note @ref --file <path> and/or --stdin). Current command only accepts positional message, which makes multiline/special-character notes brittle and conflicts with the convention to use file-based payloads for safe shell handling.

Reflection follow-up: kspec batch can fail during copy-back with ENOTEMPTY on .kspec/sessions/<session-id> (observed while batching task start+note). The batch reports all subcommands succeeded, but exits non-zero and leaves shadow worktree in a temporarily broken/deleted-file state until manual recovery (e.g., git -C .kspec restore .). Improve batch copy-back robustness for session blob directories and avoid failing the batch when payload writes succeeded.

enhanced-setup.test.ts: 'should render core skills to codex output when codex is detected' fails — .codex/config.toml not created. Pre-existing failure (confirmed by stash test). Likely related to completed task @01KJEWKG — may need test update to match new codex config behavior.

Fix pre-existing test failure: tests/enhanced-setup.test.ts 'should render core skills to codex output when codex is detected' fails with ENOENT on .codex/config.toml — test expects setup to create codex config but it is not being created. Confirmed pre-existing (not introduced by recent changes). Investigate whether codex config generation is missing or test fixture setup is incomplete.

CLI has no way to reparent a spec item (move it under a different parent). kspec item set has no --parent flag, kspec item patch doesn't accept parent_ref. If plan import places specs at the wrong level, the only fix is manual YAML editing — violating the 'use CLI, not manual edits' rule. Discovered during agent-runtime plan import review.

kspec shadow restore command: dedicated recovery for restoring sessions/, specific files, or snapshots from remote/commit without raw git. Prevents agents from cd-ing into .kspec/ for recovery (which poisons shell CWD). Needs design work — what restore scenarios to support, how to handle conflicts, UX for choosing recovery point.

kspec cleanup command: umbrella command that runs all stale-data cleanup in one shot — workflow prune (stale runs), session pruning (old blobs), maybe inbox triage of old items. Similar to 'docker system prune'. Could run on session start or as a standalone command. Would have prevented 40+ stale workflow runs accumulating.

Create a 'cli-utilities' skill (or similar) that documents shared CLI helpers — parseIntOption, exit codes, output helpers — with when/how to use each. Add a meta convention reinforcing 'check this skill before implementing new CLI commands'. Prevents agents from reaching for parseInt+isNaN when parseIntOption exists.

CLI filter options must be backed by schema fields — Zod strips unknown fields on parse, so --tag filtering silently returned nothing because tags wasn't in AgentSchema. Consider a lint rule or convention: before adding a --filter-by-X option, verify X exists in the relevant schema.

task.title: Implement Daemon Agent Dispatch Integration
task.closed_reason: Merged in PR #635. Implemented daemon agent dispatch integration: added InvocationEvent type and onInvocationEvent callback to DispatchEngine, GET /api/agent/status and POST /api/agent/dispatch endpoints, POST /api/agent/events for CLI event emission, WebSocket broadcasts via pubsub on invocation lifecycle, and postDispatchEvent() fire-and-forget helper in CLI task commands. All 7 ACs covered. E2E test suite added in api-agent-dispatch.spec.ts.

task.title: Implement CLI Agent Commands
task.closed_reason: Merged in PR #634. Implemented kspec agent command family (list, run, dispatch start/stop/status) in src/cli/commands/agent.ts. All 10 own ACs covered and all 5 trait ACs (@trait-json-output, @trait-semantic-exit-codes, @trait-error-guidance, @trait-dry-run, @trait-filterable-list) covered or N/A-annotated. 25 integration tests pass. 4 fix cycles addressed: empty task binding, dry-run overrides, --limit/--offset validation, and daemon shutdown calling stopAllEngines().

task.title: Implement Agent Dispatch Engine
task.closed_reason: Merged in PR #634. Implemented Agent Dispatch Engine in src/agent-runtime/dispatch.ts with in-memory FIFO queue, configurable concurrency, event deduplication, file watcher integration, and shadow branch mutex. All 12 spec ACs covered across 1057-line test file. 4 fix cycles addressed: filter bypass, retry stall, adapter note, abort signals, shutdown race, and dispatched engine stop on daemon shutdown. All CI passing.
